meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

copy.tagline: 让智能助手具备部署网站的能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望智能助手能自动把网站发布上线
copy.tagline_en: Enable your assistant to deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to deploy websites for you

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 智能体安装 Vercel CLI,并配置 OneCLI 自动注入 Vercel 凭证。之后智能体可直接运行 Vercel 部署命令,如部署到生产环境、查看部署列表等。
howto.when: 当用户想让智能体将 Web 应用部署到 Vercel 时触发。技能会引导安装 CLI、配置凭证并同步到所有智能体。

say.text: 把这个项目部署到 Vercel。
say.note: 会执行 vercel deploy 命令。

say.text: 部署到生产环境,给我访问链接。
查看当前的 Vercel 部署列表。

howto.what_en: Installs the Vercel CLI in NanoClaw agent containers and configures OneCLI to inject Vercel credentials. Agents can then run Vercel deployment commands, such as deploying to production or listing deployments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel. The skill walks through installing the CLI, configuring credentials, and syncing to agents.

say_en.text: Deploy to production and give me the link.
